card.name: Co- at the start of compound terms
card.fires_on: The word 'co' (or 'CO') that begins a hyphenated or joined compound such as co-infected, co-registered, co-morbid, co-benefits or co-located. It fires on the co itself, before the hyphen.

modes.label: Co-infected patients
modes.description: CO or Co starting 'co-infected' in hepatitis B and HIV or HCV warnings.
modes.example: WARNING: RISK OF HEPATITIS B VIRUS REACTIVATION IN PATIENTS<< CO>>INFECTED WITH HCV AND HB

modes.label: Other co- compounds
modes.description: Lowercase co before a hyphen in terms like co-registered, co-located, co-morbid or co-benefits.
modes.example: use<< co>>-registered anatomical imaging to improve localization
